annotations.title: Money value: inflation math from the official CPI

description: Returns inflation math for a country: what an amount from one year is worth in another, the total price change, the average yearly rate and the latest inflation rate. The US series is the Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI-U, monthly, from 1913. Other countries use the national consumer price index as published by the World Bank, yearly. Inputs are amount, from, to and country. Applies to questions about what an amount from one year is worth in another year, or how prices changed over time. Today's interest rates and pay for a job are outside this result.

amount.description: Amount in the country's currency (dollars for the US)

country.description: Country name or two-letter code; defaults to the United States. Amounts are in that country's currency.

from.description: Year (1990), or for the US a month (1990-06), the amount is from

to.description: Year or month to convert to; defaults to the latest figure

name: check_inflation
